why: Expression cycle 16 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-16.md) lost 19 of its 40 round-0 points to lessons the kit could already do (class `skill`), all P3. X1 (word economy) lost a point on 5 of 6 cases although every builder wrote the read-aloud pass cycle 15's skill row added: three passes found the repeat and kept it with a reason (n75 '3.4 %' in the hero and on its bar and '236' in a subtitle and a footer, 'a second place by design'; n79 '31' and '5' in the strip and again as bar labels, 'the mark's own place'; n80 the winner's numbers in the strip and the table, 'Kept repeats'), and three missed shapes the pass does not name: a strip meter that prints its value beside the figure (n78), a window restated by the page title, a card title and its subtitle (n77), a measure named in every pane title and the subtitle (n80). Three builders let a table of 6 to 18 rows fall to phone cards that run past a screen at 390, under the skill's ten-row threshold for `phone: 'columns'` (n78, n79, n80), and one left a column out of every card (n78's provider).
what: Skill and rule text for the skill findings of expression cycle 16: a read-aloud pass that cuts what it finds, phone tables sized to a screen, a sign on every compared figure, one view, heat-grid legends that say their cap and unit, and the single lessons the builders missed.
